githubWorkspace.target: All GitHub workspace repositories and source folders become SEIS-governed child agents, source snapshots, or hidden migration sources.
githubWorkspace.publicVisibilityRule: Only SEIS should be public-facing until a source has been imported and represented as a SEIS child agent.

requiredEvidence: sources/<repo>/<branch> ref exists in SEIS or a verified source snapshot exists
SEIS child-agent manifest names the source owner, scope, commands, and rollback owner
README or docs route users to SEIS instead of the old source repository
GitHub API/CLI confirms the source repository visibility before any mutation
explicit maintainer confirmation is recorded for archive/private/delete apply

toolingAttribution.intent: Make the public SEIS surface easier to discover and make AI tooling participants visible without implying sponsorship.

partners.role: execution, automation, repository operations, and AI-native workflow support
partners.attributionRule: Mention as tooling used or supported; do not imply OpenAI sponsorship.

partners.role: architecture, long-context reasoning, and secondary AI workflow support
partners.attributionRule: Mention as tooling used or supported; do not imply Anthropic sponsorship.

requiredBeforeApply: gh repo list succeeds for the owner
non-SEIS public repositories are listed in a dry-run plan
the maintainer chooses archive, private, transfer, or keep for each non-SEIS repository
rollback owner and public communication note are confirmed
